{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print('QA orders found:', len(qa_orders))
print('QA order order_ids:', qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]
print('After filtering QA and refunded orders, shape:', completed_only.shape)

# Also check for any other invalid revenue (e.g., negative)
print('Min revenue:', completed_only['revenue_clean'].min())
print('Max revenue:', completed_only['revenue_clean'].max())"}
